### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34599`; no other closing verb in the body. No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. `mergeable_state` clean. |
| Scope | 9 files, all inside claim 6937484576 (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/**` and root `.changeset/`): `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx`, the new `formDirtyReport.ts`, two existing test files, the changeset. No locale or e2e file moved. |
| ADR-0035 Decision §6 | The bar stays in `MasterDetailForm`, now `sticky bottom-0 z-10 bg-background` with an opaque `after:` strip, as a direct child of the form's root; neither `ModalForm` nor `DrawerForm` draws a footer in its master-detail arm (pinned: one Save in the dialog, no `modal-form-footer` / `drawer-form-footer`). The form still owns its Save. |
| Clause-② `no` (the claim's condition) | `formDirtyReport.ts` (`FormDirtyReportContext`, `useReportedDirtyChange`) is imported only inside the package: neither `src/index.tsx` (`.`) nor `src/core.ts` (`./core`) names it. `MasterDetailFormProps` / `MasterDetailFormSchema` have no hunk; the only new attribute is the `data-testid="md-form-actions"` on the bar wrapper. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: no schema key. Body, changeset and claim agree. |
| Hosts without a provider | `useReportedDirtyChange(onBusDirtyChange)` returns a `useCallback` over `[onBusDirtyChange, report]`. With no provider `report` is `null`, so the callback only calls the bus handler, and its identity stays stable because `useRecordInvalidation`'s handlers come from a one-time `useState` initialiser (`recordInvalidation.ts:102`). Every `ObjectForm` / `TabbedForm` outside a master-detail overlay therefore behaves as before, with no extra resubscription of the renderer's dirty watcher. |
| The verdict | `MasterDetailForm` reports `headerDirty \|\| rowEditorDirty \|\| linesDirty` to the nearest provider and wraps the header and the row editor in providers of its own, so neither reaches the host directly. `linesDirty` is the edit save's own `linesUnsaved` diff (a blank ghost line is not input). The row-editor flag clears when the editor closes, the header flag clears in `handleSaved`, and unmount reports `false`. |
| The close path | The master-detail `Dialog` now uses the same `handleDialogOpenChange` → `attemptClose(false)` as the flat arm, and the discard `AlertDialog` is rendered inside `MobileDialogContent` in both arms (the same nesting rationale, now one shared element). `attemptClose` honours `confirmOnDiscard && isDirty`, so `confirmOnDiscard: false` still closes at once (`plugins.mdx:149` stays true, and now holds for the master-detail arm too). Explicit Cancel passes `viaCancel` and closes without asking, as in the flat arm. |
| No conflict dialog on the subform arm | Agreed with the dev's reading: the master-detail save goes through the header form's `submitHandler` into one `/api/v1/batch`, not `useOccSave`, so there is no OCC token to conflict on. The changeset says nothing about conflicts, which is right. |
| Sticky mechanics | In `ModalForm` the form sits inside `div.flex-1.overflow-y-auto` with only `Suspense` and the provider (no DOM) between, so the bar resolves against the dialog body scroller. The pins assert that the first overflow ancestor is the host's own scroller in all three hosts. The `after:` strip needs a positioned parent, which `sticky` is. |
| Tests in harness files | New pins are top-level describes in the existing `subformHosts.test.tsx` (3) and `discardGuard.test.tsx` (8), per AGENTS.md ruling 6583487846; no card-named file. Five ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob, turn the matching pins red (the header-reset one only after an edit-save pin was added, as reported). |
| Docs | No `content/docs` or `skills` sentence places the master-detail Save bar or says its dialog closes without asking; `plugins.mdx:149` (`confirmOnDiscard`) becomes more accurate. Nothing is made false. |
| Changeset | Names `@object-ui/plugin-form`, the one package whose `src` moved. Every sentence matches the diff, including "test ids `md-form-cancel` and `md-form-submit` are unchanged" and "no prop or type is added to the package's exports". |
| Tests | Real commands with output: plugin-form 233 files / 2604 passed on `c367f82d` and again on this merged head; type-check exit 0; 38 derived gates exit 0. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34657`: NOT governed, 473 lines (+432/−41). Tier S, lands through o3-B. |
| CI on this head | 52 check-runs: all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI (aggregate plus every planned shard), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI (the `md-form-submit` specs, acceptance 4), Test Core, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. |

### Notes

1. **Not driven in the live Console** (declared). The sticky claim rests on the structural pins plus the dev's Chromium probe. A glance at a long quote dialog in showcase is the cheap confirmation if the landing area boots it.
2. **Reporter reach.** Any `ObjectForm` / `TabbedForm` rendered inside `MasterDetailForm` but outside the header and row-editor providers (the line area) would report straight to the host's guard. Today nothing there renders one, so this is a shape to remember, not a defect.
3. **Out of scope, noted by the dev:** the plain `DrawerForm` footer scrolls with its content on a long form, and `RecordFormPage` has no close guard for any form. Both may deserve cards; neither is a bar here.
4. **Landing order:** this PR lands before draft #34642 (#34605); #34642 then merges main and resolves `ModalForm.tsx` (both touch the dialog body). #34645 (#34607) also touches `ModalForm.tsx` in disjoint hunks.
